animations.name: button-press-scale
animations.description: Active button press scale effect (scale 0.98) applied via transform-gpu class, JS-driven interaction.

insights: The design system uses a comprehensive CSS variable architecture with semantic naming (--surface-*, --content-*, --stroke-*) enabling seamless light/dark theme switching through the .dark class.
Button interactions follow a consistent 160ms ease-out-quad timing with subtle scale feedback (0.98) on press, creating responsive tactile feel without being distracting.
The page employs multiple drawer animation patterns (Vaul library) with custom cubic-bezier(.32, .72, 0, 1) easing for native-like smooth gesture interactions on mobile.
